shortDescription: The SENSEX Index decreased 121 points or 0.16 percent on Friday to close at 74782 points.The decline was led by Tata Steel (-2.25%), Indusind Bank (-1.52%) and Maruti Suzuki (-1.25%).On the upside, the strongest performers were HDFC Bank (2.12%), Tech Mahindra (0.86%) and ITC (0.83%).
